# DA-014-REF: the one DigiAsset carrier rule, written down. Hand-derived from the reference, not
# generated from either implementation:
#   DigiAsset Core DigiAsset::decodeAssetTxHeader -- the LAST nulldata output is the only one the
#   asset reader decodes; if it is not tagged "DA" the transaction is no DigiAsset transaction.
#   DigiAsset Core DigiByteTransaction (dataIndex) -- the FIRST nulldata output is offered to the
#   KYC, exchange-rate and encrypted-key readers before the asset reader, and a match ends it.
#   DigiByte Core Solver -- "nulldata" = OP_RETURN followed only by complete pushes (IsPushOnly).
# The wallet's answer, failing closed:
#   NONE        no output is tagged "DA"
#   CARRIER:<i> output <i> is the transaction's only nulldata output AND its only tagged output,
#               and its payload classifies (first and last nulldata at once)
#   UNDECIDED   anything else with a tagged output: nothing credited, every output held
# Checked by native (BRTxAssetCarrier, host KAT asset_carrier_reference_kat) and by Kotlin
# (DigiAssetCarrierRule, DigiAssetCarrierVectorsTest). Change the rule in both, then here.
#
#   ...and a carrier at output 1 of a one-input, two- or three-output transaction whose output 0 is
#   650 sat is UNDECIDED: DigiAsset Core's encrypted-key reader takes that shape before the asset
#   reader, reading no content.
#
# v <name> <expected> [in=<input count>] [amt=<sat>,<sat>,...] <output script hex>...
#   in= defaults to 2; amt= defaults to 700 sat for every output.
